links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT answers included supporting references or sources
links.effect: References did not accompany ChatGPT answers; it did not elaborate on the most clinically relevant option when giving multiple answers. Authors conclude this makes it less useful as a primary information source.
links.quote: References did not accompany answers from ChatGPT, and ChatGPT did not elaborate on what would be considered most clinically relevant when providing multiple answers.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 against physician-derived responses for drug-related queries; tests model capabilities rather than an implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
